text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server, which protects sensitive information like passwords. Strong authentication, such as multi-factor login, helps ensure that only the right people can access accounts. Developers must also validate all user input to prevent attacks like SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Common vulnerabilities, including weak passwords and unpatched software, are often exploited by hackers. By following secure coding practices and staying informed about these risks, developers can build safer websites and protect their users from harm.
